news.analysis: Barkley was able to get into the end zone once on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do anything outside of that. He finished with just 22 yards over the course of the game and didn't catch a single pass, which really hurt his fantasy total. He will be an unreliable starter for as long as Joe Milton III remains the starting quarterback for Philadelphia moving forward.
